## 中文

支持《原神》和《崩坏：星穹铁道》的账号数据导出与装备管理。

本次更新：

- 修复 Windows HDR 下的图像时序与圣遗物识别问题。
- 原神本机服务随程序启动，扫描期间仍可查询进度及请求停止。
- 新增游戏窗口点击、短时按键移动与延迟 OCR 回馈，支持外部工具协作。

| 下载版本 | 功能 |
| --- | --- |
| **[GGScanner（推荐）](https://github.com/righttang/GGScanner/releases/latest/download/GGScanner.exe)** | 抓包、OCR 扫描与装备管理 |
| [GGScannerOCR](https://github.com/righttang/GGScanner/releases/latest/download/GGScannerOCR.exe) | OCR 扫描与装备管理，适合不需要抓包的玩家 |

本修改版基于 [Anyrainel/GGScanner](https://github.com/Anyrainel/GGScanner)，支持原神与星铁；下载与更新均来自本仓库。

非官方社区工具，使用可能存在账号风险，请自行判断。

## English

Export your account data and manage your gear in Genshin Impact and Honkai: Star Rail.

In this update:

- Fixed Windows HDR capture timing and Artifact recognition.
- The Genshin local service starts with the app and stays responsive to progress and stop requests during scans.
- Added game-window clicks, short key holds for movement, and delayed OCR feedback for companion tools.

| Download | Features |
| --- | --- |
| **[GGScanner (recommended)](https://github.com/righttang/GGScanner/releases/latest/download/GGScanner.exe)** | Packet capture, OCR scanning, and gear management |
| [GGScannerOCR](https://github.com/righttang/GGScanner/releases/latest/download/GGScannerOCR.exe) | OCR scanning and gear management, for players who don't need packet capture |

Based on [Anyrainel/GGScanner](https://github.com/Anyrainel/GGScanner). This fork serves both games and receives downloads and updates from this repository.

Unofficial community tool. Use may carry account risks; proceed at your own discretion.
